newsitem.title: USA: Two firms win $47 mln Burlington County, N.J. BANs.
newsitem.headline: Two firms win $47 mln Burlington County, N.J. BANs.

text.p: Two firms submitted on Thursday winning bids for $46.8 million of Burlington County, N.J., bond anticipation notes (BANs).
BT Securities Corp won $17 million of the notes with a 4 1/4 percent coupon and a 3.7740 percent net interest cost (NIC).
Fleet Securities won $9.8 million of the notes with a 4.40 percent coupon and a 3.7833 percent net interest cost (NIC). --U.S. Municipal Desk, 212-859-1650
